# Format Factory — Product Mutation Taskcard State Machine
# Version: 1.0
# Generated by: FORMAT-FACTORY-GOVERNANCE-REPEATABILITY-IDEMPOTENCY-CONTRACTS-001
# Date: 2026-06-08
# Extends: docs/automation/supervisor-taskcard-state-model.md

## States

### DISCOVERED
Entry: Gap or capability identified.
Required files: none.
Allowed next: EVIDENCE_LOCATED, BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Forbidden next: GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED, BACKFILLED_LEGACY_ACCEPTED, VALIDATED.
May close product work: NO. May support repeatability: NO.

### EVIDENCE_LOCATED
Entry: Source file with function exists; tests pass or absent.
Required files: source_file_path.
Allowed next: EXECUTION_CLASSIFIED, DISCOVERED.
May close: NO.

### EXECUTION_CLASSIFIED
Entry: execution_method assigned from taxonomy.
Required fields: execution_method, claim_classification.
Allowed next: CONTRACT_REQUIRED, BACKFILLED_LEGACY_ACCEPTED, REJECTED_UNGOVERNED.
May close: NO.

### CONTRACT_REQUIRED
Entry: execution_method is MANUAL_GOVERNED_BY_SKILL or SKILL_GUIDED_AGENT_EXECUTION.
Required: skill_id exists in .supervisor/skill-registry.yaml.
Allowed next: CONTRACTED.
May close: NO.

### CONTRACTED
Entry: skill_id assigned, allowed_files declared, taskcard_id linked.
Required fields: skill_id, skill_version, allowed_files, taskcard_id.
Allowed next: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ASSIGNED.
May close: NO.

### IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ASSIGNED
Entry: SHA-256 idempotency_key computed per idempotency-contract.md formula.
Required fields: idempotency_key (64-char hex).
Allowed next: MUTATION_BOUNDED.
May close: NO.

### MUTATION_BOUNDED
Entry: allowed_files and protected_files declared; no forbidden paths.
Required fields: allowed_files, protected_files_checked=true.
Allowed next: MUTATION_EXECUTED.
May close: NO.

### MUTATION_EXECUTED
Entry: Function exists in source; FORMAT_FACTORY_EXECUTION marker or sidecar present.
Required files: source_file, sidecar_or_marker.
Allowed next: DIFF_CAPTURED, BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
May close: NO.

### DIFF_CAPTURED
Entry: source_diff_path exists; before_sha256 and after_sha256 recorded.
Note: before_content must be captured BEFORE mutation (compliant rollback requirement).
Required fields: before_sha256, after_sha256, source_diff_path.
Allowed next: VALIDATED.
May close: NO.

### VALIDATED
Entry: Focused tests pass; product_code_ledger has entry; validation_log captured.
Required files: validation_log, ledger_entry.
Allowed next: REPLAY_RECIPE_RECORDED, GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED.
May close: YES.
Note: GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED without REPLAY_RECIPE sets claim=GOVERNED_BUT_NOT_REPLAYED.

### REPLAY_RECIPE_RECORDED
Entry: replay_recipe_path exists with skill_id, inputs, validation commands.
Required files: replay_recipe_path.
Allowed next: GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED, REPLAY_TESTED.
May close: YES. May support repeatability: YES.

### REPLAY_TESTED
Entry: replay_run_log exists; result is NO_OP or EQUIVALENT_DIFF.
Required fields: replay_result.
Allowed next: GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED.
May close: YES. Claim allowed: REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN.

### GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED
Entry: All required fields for execution_method present; tests pass.
Required fields: execution_method, claim_classification, idempotency_key (grace for pre-taxonomy),
source_diff_path (grace for pre-taxonomy), validation_logs.
May close: YES.

### BACKFILLED_LEGACY_ACCEPTED
Entry: execution_method=BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION; tests pass; sidecar present.
Required files: sidecar_attribution_path.
Required fields: execution_method=BACKFILLED_LEGACY_EXECUTION, claim_classification=LEGACY_BACKFILLED,
idempotency_key.
May close: YES (for functionality). May support repeatability: NO.
Note: Create separate replay taskcard to upgrade to REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN.

### REJECTED_UNGOVERNED
Entry: execution_method is MANUAL_UNGOVERNED or UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_METHOD.
Allowed next: EXECUTION_CLASSIFIED (reclassify, not silent transition).
May close: NO.

### BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Entry: Required artifacts missing; investigation stalled.
Allowed next: EXECUTION_CLASSIFIED, DISCOVERED.
May close: NO.

## Hard Rules
1. DISCOVERED to GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED without intermediate states: FORBIDDEN.
2. GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED requires DIFF_CAPTURED and VALIDATED always.
3. GOVERNANCE_ACCEPTED without REPLAY_RECIPE: sets claim=GOVERNED_BUT_NOT_REPLAYED.
4. REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN requires REPLAY_TESTED with actual execution log.
5. BACKFILLED_LEGACY_ACCEPTED does NOT count as REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN.
6. REJECTED_UNGOVERNED must not silently transition; supervisor review required.
